disposition_reason: As, Cd, Pb, Co, Cr, Cu and Ni were measured by ICP-OES in 27 domestic and imported wheat flours from Sulaimani markets; Table 1 prints mean ± SD for each sample.

study.design: Market survey of 27 wheat flour samples (domestic and imported)
study.origin: Iraq (domestic) and Türkiye, Germany, UAE, Kuwait, Russia, India, France, Italy, Iran
study.market: different market locations in Sulaimani, Kurdistan Region, Iraq
study.method: Microwave digestion (HNO3/H2O2), ICP-OES (Shimadzu ICPE-9820), three technical replicates
study.lod_text: As 0.002 mg/L, Pb 0.003 mg/L (solution); LOQ not stated

regulatory_or_exposure.value: As 1.0, Cd 0.1, Pb 0.2 mg/kg; FAO/WHO Co 0.03, Cr 1.0, Ni 0.1 mg/kg; Codex Cu 10.0 mg/kg

unresolved: Flour type column uses merged cells: F17 and F25 are labelled whole wheat; the rest appear to be white flour but the grouping is not explicit.
Cd and Ni means printed as 0.00 with non-zero SD are flagged and given no value.
Wet or dry basis not stated (flour as sold).
Text says Pb was below the LOD in all samples except F0, while Table 1 prints '< LOQ'.
